prompt: Rewrite the following as a warm thank-you note without exaggeration: 'You watered the plants while I was away. The basil looks better than before. You also noticed the window was leaking. I appreciated the message and the towel you put there.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: Thank you for watering the plants while I was away. It was lovely to come home and see them doing well—the basil actually looks better than it did before I left! I’m also grateful that you noticed the leaking window, sent me a message, and put a towel down. It was reassuring to know you’d spotted it and taken care of things in the moment. I really appreciate the time and care you took while I was gone.
